verdict.rationale: cubic lets users define rules that fire automatically on pull-request events: custom agents are user-authored review rules enforced on every PR, configurable in cubic.yaml or org-wide via a cubic-config repo. Auto-approval acts on PRs according to repository policy, with shadow and live modes, and toggles like automatic thread resolution add further automatic actions. However, triggers are limited to the fixed PR-review lifecycle, not general user-defined event→action automation. Missing for 10: arbitrary event sources and custom action definitions (e.g., webhooks or workflow rules beyond review), documentation of rule conditions/trigger configuration, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
